G0.name: Business Approval
entry_criteria: Business opportunity or user request formulated
exit_criteria: Executive summary and problem statement defined
Target user personas identified
Value proposition and success KPIs quantified
Scope boundaries explicitly documented

G1.name: Requirements Approval
exit_criteria: All functional requirements have REQ-XXX identifiers
Given/When/Then acceptance criteria specified for every requirement
Non-functional requirements (latency, availability, security) quantified
Edge cases, boundary conditions, and error states detailed

G2.name: Architecture Approval
exit_criteria: System and domain context diagrams rendered in Mermaid
API and data contracts defined in docs/api/
Applicable ADRs authored and marked ACCEPTED
Challenged and reviewed by technical-critic with zero open BLOCKERS

G3.name: Implementation Readiness
required_artifacts: Technical implementation plan with file list
exit_criteria: Files to Create, Modify, or Delete identified
Dependencies and worktree allocations defined
Testing strategy and assertion targets planned

G4.name: Code Quality Review
exit_criteria: Zero linting errors or formatting violations
Type annotations present on public interfaces
Zero silent catch blocks or swallowed exceptions
Independent review conducted with zero open BLOCKERS

G5.name: Functional Quality
exit_criteria: 100% of automated unit and integration tests passing
Terminal test execution output captured and verified
Code branch coverage at or above 85% on modified code
All test cases annotated with requirement traceability IDs

G6.name: Security Quality
exit_criteria: Secret scanner reports zero plaintext credentials or tokens
SAST / Static security analysis reports zero HIGH/CRITICAL issues
Dependency CVE audit clean
Threat model verified

G7.name: Performance Quality
exit_criteria: p95 latency under agreed budget (default < 200ms)
p99 latency under agreed budget (default < 500ms)
Zero memory leaks or file descriptor leaks during sustained load
Resource utilization within safe capacity limits

G8.name: Release Readiness
entry_criteria: Gate G0 through G7 verified as PASSED
exit_criteria: Semantic version bumped appropriately
CHANGELOG updated with categorized release notes
Rollback runbook tested and documented
Release approval sign-off obtained

G9.name: Production Acceptance
exit_criteria: Deployment executed cleanly without unplanned downtime
Post-deployment smoke tests passed 100%
Health endpoints (/healthz, /ready) returning 200 OK
Zero regression in error rates post-rollout

G10.name: Operational Acceptance
exit_criteria: Telemetry pipeline ingesting logs, metrics, and traces
Dashboards rendering real-time telemetry
SLO alerting rules armed and operational
Runbooks verified and accessible

G11.name: Closure & Governance
exit_criteria: Complete traceability chain verified from OBJ-XXX to release
Documentation confirmed synchronized with codebase
DORA metrics recorded
Lessons learned and retrospective archived
Task marked CLOSED in traceability ledger
